scope: Customer-account ledger initialization/policy and customer/checkout Dojo monitoring integration

changes: An explicit manual ledger post validates its shape, customer and adjustment actor before creating a missing account inside the same transaction.
The default account is held, with zero purchase limit and zero initial balance; the ledger movement and account creation commit or roll back together.
MariaDB keeps the existing dataset/report/restore guards and customer identity lock, then checks/locks the account before inserting it. Existing accounts are not upserted or reconfigured on replay.
Read APIs stay side-effect-free. Checkout sale mutations retain their original account requirement and purchasing guards.

Parent native follow-up exposed misleading checkbox semantics: unchecked isEnabled=false was labelled Account on hold. The stable visible/accessibility label is now Allow Pay Later purchases, with separate held/active description. Opening another customer clears the previous enabled/limit draft before reading; no account configuration is saved implicitly.
tests: customerAccountSettings.test.ts: disabled initial draft, enabled-to-held account switch, failed read reset, explicit save boolean mapping, and stable checkbox semantics
findings.limits: Native Tauri new-customer workflow and MariaDB first-writer concurrency were not executed by this agent.

changes: Purchase hold and credit limit apply to charge entries, not historical opening balances or manager corrections.
Native opening_balance and adjustment posts require a nonblank reason and a currently active employee with adjust_customer_account permission, using the stored role-permission matrix.
Historical entries preserve account hold, credit limit and configuration. The customer dialog explains this policy.
Parent agent owns matching database.ts preview validation changes.
findings.limits: No native UI PASS claimed; MariaDB authorization/create path compiled but was not run against a disposable MariaDB database.

changes: Customer-account Dojo monitoring exposes Cancel Terminal while the monitor is active, then disables repeated requests.
Cancellation requests feed the existing monitor; they do not dismiss the payment, record cancellation, release the lease early or authorize a new charge.

An uncertain result preserves the journal, displays a persistent do-not-retry warning and disables submission/payment-method changes in the current dialog, directing the operator to administrator Reports / Payment checks recovery.
Definitive capture still wins after an operator cancellation; the monitor never sends another card retry after a cancellation decision takes precedence.

After the final cancelled/failed journal update succeeds, the customer modal replaces temporary cancellation/decline prompts with the confirmed result and states that no account payment was recorded. Uncertain outcomes retain their recovery warning.
tests: customerDojoIntegration.test.ts executes extracted production takeDojoAccountPayment and cancellation handlers with mock provider/native callbacks, including final cancelled and declined/Return to payment status messages
dojoSessionFlow.test.ts cancellation, late capture, lease renewal and cancellation-versus-retry cases
findings.limits: The actual customer-account modal and terminal cancellation were not exercised in native Tauri by this agent. No real charge or provider call was made.

changes: Customer monitoring now supplies cancelExpiredSandboxDojoPaymentIntent(reference), binding the original durable attempt ID.
The parent applied the same callback in checkout; an AST/execution regression checks both real production monitor option objects.
The existing monitor invokes cleanup only for Sandbox plus Expired plus Created, retains the lease, and obtains fresh payment-intent proof after cleanup.
Cleanup acknowledgement alone remains uncertain; a racing Captured outcome wins even when native cleanup rejects. Live and Unknown environments never invoke sandbox cleanup.
tests: customerDojoIntegration.test.ts sandbox cancellation, uncertain acknowledgement, late capture, Live/Unknown exclusion, and both route callback bindings
dojoSessionFlow.test.ts matching provider identity, lease retention/loss, final proof and late capture
findings.limits: Native TIP0 provider integration is reserved for the parent agent. These fixtures are not sandbox UAT or live-payment certification.
